name: Relative volume
inputs: Final bar volume; 20 previous comparable session-slot volumes; venue and unit
method: RVOL = current / median(previous same-slot volumes). Candidate at RVOL >= 3 with at least 20 valid observations. Threshold is provisional.
guard: Exclude opening/closing auctions, half-days, unit changes and nonpositive baselines. A news-driven increase is still unusual but not misconduct.
source_role_note: R02 motivates intraday volatility seasonality; it does not supply the same-slot median-volume formula, RVOL3 threshold or20-observation rule.

name: Robust return deviation
inputs: Completed closes; corporate actions; prior same-interval log returns
method: r=ln(Ct/Ct-1); z=(r-median(history))/(1.4826*MAD(history)). Candidate |z|>=4 and |simple return|>=1%, after 20 valid references.
guard: Exclude corporate-action discontinuities; zero MAD means abstain, not infinity. No sigma-to-probability conversion.
source_role_note: Financial stylized facts and intraday-volatility context motivate robust baselines; MAD scale, z4,1%floor and20-reference rule are project design.

name: Benchmark divergence
inputs: Aligned asset and benchmark returns; point-in-time benchmark mapping
method: Default residual e=asset log return-benchmark log return (beta=1 explicitly). Flag robust residual |z|>=4; fitted alpha/beta is later.
guard: A beta-one baseline is approximate; reject mismatched time windows or stale benchmark. No claim that benchmark fully explains causality.
source_role_note: R01 is contextual financial behavior evidence; beta-one benchmark subtraction and robust residual threshold are project rules.

name: Realized volatility shift
inputs: Final returns over current and preceding equal-size windows
method: Compare sqrt(sum(r^2)) for equal-duration comparable windows; investigate high past-distribution quantile.
guard: Overlapping windows are dependent; remove overnight gaps and adjust for missing bars.
source_role_note: R02 concerns intraday dynamics. R04 documents online changepoint inference, but the catalog uses sqrt(sum(r^2)) window comparison rather than implementing that algorithm; neither derives its quantile rule.

name: Joint price and volume event
inputs: AN-MKT-001 and 002; optional 003; same completed window
method: Join qualifying signals within one bar interval into one event; default HIGH, not CRITICAL.
guard: Treat return/momentum/volatility as one market-price family; syndicated news does not provide independent confirmation.
label_tr: Fiyat ve işlem hacminde olağandışı hareket
source_role_note: R11 supports general joint price/volume anomaly screening. The robust-score/RVOL adaptation, one-bar merge and HIGH severity are project rules; R11 does not validate their thresholds.

name: Spread/liquidity deterioration
inputs: Licensed synchronized bid/ask observations; quote age; tick size
method: Relative spread=(ask-bid)/mid; compare same-slot distribution and persistence.
guard: Trades/OHLCV cannot reconstruct a spread; crossed/stale quotes are data errors.
source_role_note: R01 supplies broad financial context, not a validated spread/liquidity detector.

name: Cross-venue price divergence
inputs: Simultaneous prices of identical economic asset, FX and fees
method: Compare FX-normalized robust venue differences against own baseline.
guard: Bridged/wrapped assets, stale books and transfer restrictions can explain differences. Not an arbitrage recommendation.
source_role_note: Cross-venue FX/fee normalization and robust difference baseline are project design; R01 is background only.

name: Fund NAV/category divergence
inputs: Published NAV total returns; dated category membership; comparable peers
method: Compare matched valuation dates and currencies; median peer return plus robust residual, minimum 10 eligible peers.
guard: Foreign-market valuation lag, FX, mandate and distributions can explain differences; daily not intraday NAV.
source_role_note: R10 studies fund-flow/search/performance relationships, not this median-peer divergence or10-peer threshold.

name: Return-adjusted net-flow estimate
inputs: Two aligned AUM and NAV observations; distribution and unit-change status
method: Estimated flow=At-Aprev*(NAVt/NAVprev); rate=flow/Aprev. Investigate |rate|>=10% only after historical baseline checks.
guard: No dates, placeholders or corporate restructuring => abstain. End-period approximation, not reported cash flow. Investor counts do not measure flow.
label_tr: Tahmini net fon akışında belirgin değişim
source_role_note: R10 motivates flow context; its abstract-only inspected depth does not establish this exact NAV-ratio/distribution convention. Return adjustment and10%trigger are project design.

name: Investor count change
inputs: At least two dated valid investor counts; history of comparable frequency
method: Percent and absolute change against past distribution; use provisional absolute percentage change >=10% plus absolute count change >=100 investors as a review trigger.
guard: Source defaults zero are missing; count definition changes/mergers cause breaks. Does not measure capital moved.
source_role_note: R10 is fund-flow context; it does not validate investor-count changes as monetary flows or the10%/100-investor rule.

name: Asset-type allocation shift
inputs: Two comparable published allocation snapshots; stable category mapping
method: For nonnegative distributions summing to one: D=0.5*sum(abs(wt-wprev)); candidate D>=0.20 or single category >=20 percentage points.
guard: Price effects may change weights without trades. Negative/leverage weights use a separate signed exposure model; do not normalize them away.
source_role_note: S06 is maintainer provider implementation evidence about field/interface behavior, not mathematical validation or an independently tested/entitled endpoint. Total variation and0.20threshold are project design.

name: Fund access/regulatory event
inputs: Official decision; exact affected fund identities; publication/effective dates
method: Structured extraction and entity validation; classify access restriction, liquidation notice or material prospectus change.
guard: Notice is a verified event, not a statistical anomaly or verdict on unlisted funds. Current status requires subsequent updates.
source_role_note: Official SPK notices provide factual context/source class; exact per-fund identity/action/status must come from the relevant decision. Extraction/entity validation is project process, not a validated model.

name: Reported holding concentration
inputs: Security-level published holdings and reporting dates
method: Compute sum of top positions or HHI over verified comparable security weights.
guard: Asset-type allocation cannot supply this signal; stale holdings and fund-of-fund look-through must be labeled.
source_role_note: R10 is not an HHI/holding-concentration method reference. Top-position/HHI definitions and publication freshness rules are project design.

name: Potential liquidity mismatch
inputs: Dated holdings, redemption terms and licensed underlying liquidity measures
method: Review weighted illiquid exposure against disclosed redemption horizon.
guard: Without reliable holdings and terms, insufficient evidence; not a claim of inability to redeem.
source_role_note: S03 is regulatory contextual evidence; it does not supply licensed holdings liquidity, redemption terms or validate weighted liquidity mismatch.

name: Material issuer disclosure
inputs: KAP text; amount/currency/period; matching financial scale
method: LLM extracts structured claims; deterministic math computes disclosed contract/TTM sales ratio if comparable.
guard: Multi-year contract is not current-year revenue; currency/date/tax context required; no contract-profit inference.
source_role_note: R13 motivates retrieval-augmented language generation, not the contract/TTM ratio or materiality judgement. Existing S09(SEC EDGAR) is excluded because it does not document KAP. KAP subscriber documentation S34 supplies the relevant Turkish interface; entitlement remains open.

name: US filing/earnings context
inputs: SEC accession and acceptance time; valid financial-period facts
method: Classify event, retrieve prior comparable period and calculate supported differences.
guard: GAAP/non-GAAP, cumulative periods and revised facts cannot be mixed. No EPS surprise without licensed point-in-time consensus.
source_role_note: SEC submission/XBRL API documentation addresses retrieval and dated filings, not correctness of automatic classification, period comparison or EPS surprises.

name: Profit/cash-flow divergence
inputs: Comparable filed income/cash-flow statements; sector and accounting regime
method: Compare earnings, operating cash flow and receivables using period-consistent ratios.
guard: Negative denominators, inflation restatements, seasonality and bank accounting require separate models. Not accounting fraud.
label_tr: Kâr ve nakit akışı farklı yönlerde değişti
source_role_note: SEC APIs address retrieval of filed facts; accounting divergence ratios/sector rules are project design, not validated fraud inference.

name: Source correction/material update
inputs: Prior and new official document versions; affected event IDs
method: Content/version diff; revalidate citations and update or invalidate dependent events.
guard: Do not erase original record; correction notifications require separate dedup class.
source_role_note: R15 supports citation completeness/entailment evaluation only. Document-version diff, event invalidation and correction lifecycle are project process; no source-accuracy guarantee follows.

name: Large finalized transfer
inputs: Verified chain/contract, decimals, finalized tx/log; supply or past transfer baseline
method: Compare transfer size with known supply/past sizes. MVP may display fact only where baseline absent.
guard: Transfer is not sale; exchange attribution unknown unless dated label evidence. Internal treasury transfers and bridges are alternatives.
source_role_note: S11 supplies raw RPC transaction/log data concepts; identity and sale inference do not follow. R12 concerns exchange/channel pump events, not a validated large-transfer detector.

name: Token-account concentration
inputs: Mint/contract supply and verified account balances; account roles where known
method: Compute observed top-account share; Solana top 20 is partial account coverage.
guard: Exchanges, liquidity pools, vesting and burn accounts are not independent beneficial owners. No wallet clustering claim.
source_role_note: S12 documents largest token accounts(top20), not20 beneficial owners. Top-account/supply ratio and account-role caveats are project design.

name: Pool-liquidity change
inputs: Comparable same-pool reserve/supply snapshots and prices
method: Separate reserve-unit changes from mark-to-market USD changes; compare against own history.
guard: Single current snapshot cannot establish prior withdrawal; V3 liquidity ranges and rebalancing need specialized handling.
source_role_note: S13 documents pair-level API snapshots, not assumed history or a validated liquidity-withdrawal detector; reserve/price separation is project design.

name: Token authority/contract change
inputs: Known ABI/program capability and finalized verified state transitions
method: Compare supported mint/freeze/upgrade/admin permissions across versions.
guard: Permission existence alone is not exploit evidence; proxy/Token-2022 semantics require explicit support.
source_role_note: S11 offers base RPC capabilities but not contract/proxy permission semantics. S12(getTokenLargestAccounts) is an ecosystem/account-data entrypoint, not authority/Token2022 documentation.

name: Scheduled supply unlock
inputs: Verified issuer vesting schedule; circulating supply; revisions
method: Calculate dated scheduled unlock share and relevance; label scheduled, not observed transfer.
guard: Schedule can change; already liquid allocations differ from new supply. No forecasted price effect.
source_role_note: R12 is manipulation background only; it does not document issuer vesting schedules or validate supply unlock alerts.

name: Market/on-chain contextual event
inputs: Qualified market event plus finalized on-chain observation with matching asset/window
method: Create one event with separate evidence families; LLM investigates plausible links and alternatives.
guard: Temporal co-occurrence is not causal coordination; combined magnitude alone cannot become global CRITICAL.
label_tr: Piyasa ve zincir üstü verilerde eş zamanlı hareket
source_role_note: R11 supports market screening only; R14 supports interleaved tool interaction at a conceptual level. Neither validates market/on-chain causal linkage, timing, severity or confidence; R12 explains excluded coordination evidence.

name: Fund/share relationship event
inputs: Published security holdings, fund event, licensed stock event, availability timestamps
method: Relate historical disclosed exposure to contemporaneous market evidence.
guard: Never infer present-day holdings or directional causation from old allocation classes.
source_role_note: S03 supplies regulatory context, not a point-in-time security-level exposure/stock relationship detector.

name: Stale or failed source
inputs: Expected calendar/cadence; heartbeat; last valid observation
method: Compare last valid availability against source schedule; set stale/circuit-open.
guard: Weekends and unreleased NAV are not outages. Operational warning, not asset financial severity.
source_role_note: S04 is an official fund-value discovery page; it does not establish a tested publication cadence/heartbeat contract. Schedule-aware staleness rules are project design.

name: Missing/placeholder/invalid observation
inputs: Provider raw record and schema; field-level quality
method: Flag null/default placeholders, inconsistent units, invalid OHLC or unidentified dates.
guard: Do not convert missing into zero. Quarantine record; skip dependent detector.
label_tr: Bu gösterge için yeterli veri yok
source_role_note: S06 provides maintainer code evidence about placeholder/default behavior, not a guarantee for every live field or provider. Quarantine/schema/unit rules are project design.

name: Corporate-action/session break
inputs: Action calendar, adjusted-state metadata, session calendar
method: Mark baseline-incompatible periods and suppress mechanically induced discontinuities.
guard: Price split is not a crash; unresolved adjustment means no claim, not guessed correction.
source_role_note: Stylized financial behavior and session dynamics are background; corporate-action calendars, adjustment-state checks and suppression are project process.
